title: Tag-along object follows the incoming missile in the Bluegill Triple Prime report

tellings.quote: Uh but when you did that, you noticed that there had been some object that had appeared on the screen and joined and tagged along following the incoming missile down.

related.note: Both are about the anomalous object seen at the Bluegill Triple Prime test in October 1962. Here it was an object that joined and followed the incoming missile, not material tumbling out of the plume.

plain: In 1962, during Bluegill Triple Prime, an American high-altitude nuclear test over the Pacific near Johnston Island, an object showed up on the tracking screen and "tagged along following the incoming missile down." Harold Malmgren, an adviser to presidents in the 1960s, says he saw this in the test's report, and he places it among officials such as President John F. Kennedy, his advisers McGeorge Bundy and Robert McNamara, John McNaughton and Lyndon B. Johnson. If true, something unknown was shadowing a US nuclear test.
